note: Extension fields for fantasy characters, added on top of the base `character.md` schema. Machine source: the `fc-character-fantasy` FileClass, which `extends: fc-character`. Apply this FileClass to characters that need species/combat/magic facts; otherwise the base character schema is enough.

fields.name: species
fields.description: Select — e.g. `Human | HighElf | DarkElf | WoodElf | Dwarf | Halfling | Orc | Ogre | Beastfolk | Catfolk | Merfolk | Fae | Pixie | Dragonkin | Demon | Undead | Mystical | Other`. The character's species/ancestry.

fields.name: combat_skills
fields.description: List. Combat abilities, drawn from the value-list note `fc-combat-skills` in the FileClasses folder.

fields.name: magical_abilities
fields.description: List. Magical abilities, drawn from the value-list note `fc-magical-abilities` in the FileClasses folder.

fields.name: other_skills
fields.description: Text. Non-combat, non-magical skills worth tracking.

fields.name: weapons
fields.description: List of text. Weapons the character characteristically carries.

fields.name: armor
fields.description: List. Armour, drawn from the value-list note `fc-armor` in the FileClasses folder.

fields.name: magical_items
fields.description: Text. Notable magical items carried (for canonical objects, prefer a `[[wikilink]]` to an object note).
